summary: Connect Biopharma Holdings filed a Form 8-K on September 15, 2026, furnishing a press release and corporate presentation under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing topline results from its global Phase 2 Asthma Study of rademikibart, an anti-IL-4-receptor alpha antibody. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial enrolled 160 patients dosed 1:1 with 600mg subcutaneous rademikibart (n=79) or placebo (n=81) plus standard of care. The primary endpoint was treatment failure within 28 days; the key secondary endpoint, post-bronchodilator FEV1 change at Week 1, showed a 130mL greater improvement versus placebo (p=0.023). No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; this is a routine clinical-results disclosure.
